scope: Read-only recomputation from archived calibration scores and five-seed z cache; no RNG or trajectory generation

calibration.cause_boundary: Calibration files establish [0,0] score bounds, eight retained candidates and no solver reject. Calibration z and per-event supports were not persisted, so exact per-event normal geometry cannot be reconstructed without rerunning calibration. The implemented score path classifies the convex-hull distance as zero/unresolved, including the Qhull tolerance path; this is distinct from an empty set or solver error.

zero_rule: score lower bound <=1e-10 yields zero/unresolved proposal; strict gate is score > threshold
